pieces.Text: You grow an extra tail that represents your growing magical powers.

You gain a new spell-like ability, each usable twice per day, from the following list, in order: Disguise Self, Charm Person, Misdirection, Invisibility, Suggestion, Displacement, Confusion, Dominate Person. For example, the first time you select this feat, you gain disguise self 2/day; the second time you select this feat, you gain charm person 2/day. Your caster level for these spells is equal to your Hit Dice. The DCs for these abilities are Charisma-based. Special: You may select this feat up to eight times. Each time you take it, you gain an additional ability as described above.
